adds.title: LGBTQ rights in Indonesia - Wikipedia
adds.summary: Wikipedia's country overview (LGBTQ rights in Indonesia) supplies the national framework under which Riau is assessed: private, consensual same-sex activity is not criminalised nationally (only Aceh applies sharia-based penalties), but Indonesia provides no anti-discrimination or hate-crime protections for sexual orientation or gender identity, and legal gender change on official documents requires sex-reassignment surgery plus a judge's approval. The page records that the penal code passed in December 2022 criminalises sex outside marriage from 2 January 2026, effectively sweeping in unmarried same-sex couples since same-sex marriage is unrecognised, and that in August 2025 police arrested three men over an alleged LGBTQ Facebook community page with up to 12 years' imprisonment possible if convicted. This is the operative baseline a trans visitor to Riau stands under; the Riau province article itself carries no provincial divergence on any of it.

adds.title: LGBTQ rights in Indonesia - Wikipedia
adds.summary: Wikipedia's country overview (LGBTQ rights in Indonesia) supplies the national framework under which East Nusa Tenggara is assessed: Aceh is the only province enforcing sharia-based criminalisation, while nationally private same-sex activity is not punished yet no anti-discrimination or hate-crime protections exist for sexual orientation or gender identity; legal gender change on official documents requires sex-reassignment surgery plus a judge's approval, and sex outside marriage becomes criminalised from 2 January 2026 under the penal-code amendment passed in December 2022. The page also records the August 2025 arrests of three men over an alleged LGBTQ Facebook community page, with up to 12 years' imprisonment possible if convicted, and the absence of any national-level protection against discrimination is the operative baseline a trans visitor to this strongly Christian-majority province stands under. The province's own article contains no trans-specific statute, raid or service record, so no local divergence from this national baseline is documented either way.
